name: imaslou-agent-kit
description: Plugins for Claude Code and Codex by Ilya Maslau: iOS/Swift code review, App Store guideline audits, pre-task interviews and feature specs, root cause analysis, debugging journals, project documentation, multi-agent debate, and AI-text humanizing.

plugins.name: ios-comprehensive-review
plugins.description: Multi-agent comprehensive iOS/Swift code review with parallel analysis, cross-file checks, and resumable stages.

plugins.name: memory-bank
plugins.description: Living project documentation with anti-hallucination verification. Commands: init, update, system-update, add-decision.

plugins.name: multi-agent-debate
plugins.description: Structured multi-agent debate that spawns parallel LLM agents for adversarial analysis and synthesis.

plugins.name: ios-quick-review
plugins.description: Efficient multi-pass iOS/Swift code review for commits or uncommitted changes.

plugins.name: root-cause-analysis
plugins.description: Systematic root cause analysis using 5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, and structured RCA reports.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Remove AI writing patterns from text. Priority-tiered detection, statistical texture, voice anchoring, two-pass self-audit.

plugins.name: appstore-guideline-auditor
plugins.description: Read-only App Store guideline audit for native iOS projects. Findings graded by severity and by evidence strength, citations checked against Apple's current text, plus a generated App Store Connect checklist.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Pre-task interview that states its assumptions, asks only the decisions it cannot look up, probes for what you have not thought of, and leaves a written brief with a readiness verdict. Command: /grill-me.

plugins.name: feature-spec
plugins.description: Turns what you already have into a critic-verified spec, asking only about what is still unclear, then turns that spec into a checked implementation plan. Commands: feature-spec, feature-spec-plan.
